disambiguation: Not a simple prompt template manager; it executes AI actions directly on the current note or selection.
intentEvidence: SkillFlow's premise: AI should live inside the tools you already use, not force you into a chat window.
motivation: To ensure AI lives inside the tools users already use, rather than forcing them into a chat window.
problem: Existing AI methods in Obsidian require retyping prompts, using simple text snippets, or searching through the command palette.
summary: SkillFlow allows users to run LLM-powered AI skills as one-click menu actions directly on notes without needing a separate chat window.
